docs.title: Step Engine
docs.text:
Step Engine is a modular 3D game engine written from scratch in C++17 and DirectX 11. It compiles from a single codebase into two distinct targets:

  • DX11Editor — A full visual authoring environment powered by Dear ImGui (Docking) and ImGuizmo, featuring live scene editing, asset management, non-destructive playtesting, and one-click game packaging.
  • DX11Runtime — A lightweight standalone game executable compiled with the DIST_BUILD preprocessor macro that strips all editor UI, mounts a packed binary .pak Virtual File System (VFS), and boots directly into gameplay.

docs.title: Key Features
docs.text: Subsystem Capabilities Forward PBR & CSM Renderer DirectX 11 hardware pipeline with Cook-Torrance microfacet BRDF (GGX, Smith Schlick-GGX, Fresnel-Schlick), tangent-space normal mapping, 3-cascade shadow maps (2048x2048 Texture2DArray with 3x3 PCF and texel snapping), up to 16 frustum-culled lights, skybox cubemaps, and off-screen editor framebuffers. Entity Component System (ECS) Cache-friendly sparse-set registry via EnTT, 14 built-in components, intrusive doubly-linked parent-child entity hierarchies (RelationshipComponent), cycle-checked reparenting, and deferred entity destruction. Multi-Threaded Physics Jolt Physics integration running on hardware_concurrency - 1 worker threads, supporting Box, Sphere, Capsule, concave static MeshShape, and dynamic ConvexHullShape colliders, raycasting with OBB fallback, and thread-safe contact callbacks. Sandboxed Lua Scripting Embedded Lua runtime bound via sol2, supporting multiple scripts per entity with isolated sol::environment sandboxes, lifecycle hooks (OnCreate, OnUpdate, OnDestroy), collision callbacks (OnCollisionEnter, OnCollisionExit), and error-protected execution. Spatial Audio miniaudio backend supporting 2D UI/music playback and 3D spatialized emitters synchronized each frame with the active camera listener and entity world transforms. 2D UI & Typography Orthographic screen-space overlay pass for 2D sprites (SpriteRendererComponent) and dynamic TrueType text (TextRendererComponent) baked at runtime into 2048x2048 RGBA glyph atlases via stb_truetype. UUID Assets, VFS & Export Persistent 64-bit Engine::UUID asset ledger (enginefiles/AssetRegistry.json), RapidJSON 4-pass scene serializer, PAK2 binary archive packer/VFS mounter, and automated ExportedGame/ packaging.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11 (x64) with DirectX 11 runtime
  • Compiler / IDE: Visual Studio 2022 with the Desktop development with C++ workload (MSVC v143, Windows 10/11 SDK, C++ CMake tools for Windows)
  • Build Tools: CMake 3.20+ and vcpkg (can be installed automatically via tools\SetupProject.bat)

docs.title: Option A: Visual Studio 2022 (Recommended)
docs.text:
1. Bootstrap CMake & vcpkg (if not already installed): Run the automated setup batch file from the repository root: 

    tools\SetupProject.bat
    This installs CMake to %LOCALAPPDATA%\w64cmake and clones/bootstraps vcpkg at %SystemDrive%\vcpkg (verifying %SystemDrive%\vcpkg\scripts\buildsystems\vcpkg.cmake).

  2. Open the Folder in Visual Studio: Launch Visual Studio 2022 and select File -> Open -> Folder..., choosing the DX11GameEngine root directory. Visual Studio detects CMakeLists.txt and CMakeSettings.json automatically.

  3. Configure CMake & Install Dependencies: Select x64-Debug or x64-Release in the configuration dropdown. Ensure cmakeToolchain in CMakeSettings.json points to ${env.SystemDrive}/vcpkg/scripts/buildsystems/vcpkg.cmake. On first run, vcpkg downloads and builds all packages in vcpkg.json.

  4. Build Both Targets: Select Build -> Build All.

  5. Building runs custom targets CopyShaders, CopyAssets, and CopyEngineFiles, mirroring shaders/, assets/, and enginefiles/ into ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin/.

  6. Building DX11Runtime triggers a POST_BUILD step that populates bin/RuntimeTemplate/ with DX11Runtime.exe and all required .dll files, enabling the Editor's Export Game button.

  7. Run the Editor: Ensure DX11Editor.exe is selected as the startup target and press Ctrl + F5 (Debug -> Start Without Debugging).

docs.title: Option B: Command-Line CMake Build
docs.text:
You can configure and build both executables directly from a terminal (or run tools\BuildGame.bat):

cmake -S . -B out/build/x64-Release -G "Visual Studio 17 2022" -A x64 `
  -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE="$env:SystemDrive/vcpkg/scripts/buildsystems/vcpkg.cmake"

cmake --build out/build/x64-Release --config Release

Compiled binaries are placed in out/build/x64-Release/bin/Release/ (DX11Editor.exe and DX11Runtime.exe).

docs.title: Architecture
docs.text:
• Core Engine Loop & Lifecycle — Initialization, frame update order, Edit <-> Play state machine, and dual build targets.
  • ECS & Entity Management — EnTT registry design, intrusive entity hierarchies, transform propagation, and deferred destruction.
  • Rendering Pipeline & Shaders — Multi-pass DirectX 11 architecture, PBR BRDF, Cascaded Shadow Maps, skybox, and 2D UI.
  • Subsystems, Physics, Audio & VFS — Jolt Physics integration, Lua sandboxing, spatial audio, UUID asset tracking, and PAK2 VFS packaging.

docs.text:

docs.text:

docs.title: ECS Components & Enums
docs.text: All ECS components and associated enumerations are declared in include/Engine/Components.h inside namespace Engine.

docs.title: Engine::MeshType
docs.text:
enum class MeshType { Cube, Sphere, Capsule, Custom };
Selects a built-in primitive mesh or custom imported mesh when attaching a MeshRendererComponent (also exposed to Lua as MeshType).

docs.title: Engine::MaterialType
docs.text:
enum class MaterialType { LitColor, UnlitColor, Textured };
- LitColor (0) — Shaded with Cook-Torrance PBR (BasicPS.hlsl) using baseColor, roughness, metallic, and 1x1 default textures; casts shadows. - UnlitColor (1) — Flat solid color (UnlitPS.hlsl) using baseColor; skipped during the shadow pass. - Textured (2) — Shaded with Cook-Torrance PBR (BasicPS.hlsl) sampling albedoMapID (t0), normalMapID (t1), and ormMapID (t2), modulated by baseColor, roughness, and metallic; casts shadows.

docs.title: Engine::CameraControlMode
docs.text:
enum class CameraControlMode { EditorCam = 0, Scripted };
Determines whether EditorCameraInputSystem processes fly-camera keyboard/mouse input for an entity (EditorCam) or leaves camera motion to scripts (Scripted).

docs.title: Engine::LightType
docs.text:
enum class LightType : unsigned int
{
    Directional = 0,
    Point       = 1,
    Spot        = 2
};
Matches the HLSL LightData::type integer values in BasicPS.hlsl.

docs.title: Engine::RBShape & Engine::RBMotion
docs.text:
enum class RBShape  { Box, Sphere, Capsule, Mesh };
enum class RBMotion { Static, Dynamic };
Configure collider geometry and Jolt motion/layer behavior (Layers::NON_MOVING vs. Layers::MOVING) on RigidBodyComponent (also exposed to Lua as RBShape and RBMotion).

docs.title: Core, Scene, Systems & Serialization API
docs.text: This page documents the foundational identifier, math utility, scene container, ECS system, and serialization interfaces declared in include/Engine/Core.h, UUID.h, MathUtils.h, Scene.h, Systems.h, and SceneSerializer.h.

docs.title: Precompiled Core Header (include/Engine/Core.h)
docs.text:
Core.h is configured as the precompiled header (target_precompile_headers) for both DX11Editor and DX11Runtime. It includes:

  • C++17 standard headers (<cstdio>, <stdexcept>, <string>, <vector>, <cstdint>)
  • SDL2 (<SDL.h>, <SDL_syswm.h>)
  • DirectX 11 (<d3d11.h>, <dxgi.h>, <d3dcompiler.h>, <wrl/client.h>, <DirectXMath.h>) and #pragma comment(lib, ...) directives for d3d11.lib, dxgi.lib, d3dcompiler.lib, and dxguid.lib
  • Jolt Physics integration ("Engine/PhysicsManager.h")

docs.title: Engine::UUID (include/Engine/UUID.h)
docs.text:
64-bit random identifier used to uniquely track assets across sessions, JSON scene files, and VFS archives. Specializes std::hash<Engine::UUID> for direct use as a key in std::unordered_map.

namespace Engine
{
    class UUID
    {
    public:
        UUID();                       // Generates a random 64-bit ID via std::mt19937_64
        UUID(uint64_t uuid);          // Constructs from an existing 64-bit integer (0 = invalid/none)
        UUID(const UUID&) = default;

        operator uint64_t() const;    // Implicit conversion to uint64_t
    };
}

docs.title: Engine::Math (include/Engine/MathUtils.h)
docs.text: Inline math helpers built on DirectXMath and DirectXCollision (left-handed coordinate system: +X right, +Y up, +Z forward, NDC depth [0, 1]).

docs.title: Engine::Math::Ray
docs.text:
struct Ray
{
    DirectX::XMFLOAT3 origin;
    DirectX::XMFLOAT3 direction;
};

docs.title: Functions
docs.text: Signature Description DirectX::XMFLOAT3 QuaternionToEulerDegrees(const DirectX::XMFLOAT4& q) Normalizes q, builds a rotation matrix, and extracts (pitch, yaw, roll) in degrees with [-1, 1] asinf clamping and ±90° gimbal-lock handling. DirectX::XMFLOAT4 EulerDegreesToQuaternion(const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& euler) Converts (pitch, yaw, roll) degrees to radians and returns a normalized quaternion via XMQuaternionRotationRollPitchYaw. Ray ScreenToWorldRay(float mouseX, float mouseY, float screenW, float screenH, const DirectX::XMMATRIX& view, const DirectX::XMMATRIX& proj) Unprojects (mouseX, mouseY) at NDC z = 0.0f and z = 1.0f (XMVector3Unproject) to construct a normalized world-space picking ray. bool RayIntersectsOBB(const Ray& ray, const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& position, const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& scale, const DirectX::XMFLOAT4& rotation, float& outDistance) Tests intersection against a unit DirectX::BoundingOrientedBox centered at position with half-extents 0.5f * scale and orientation rotation. Writes hit distance to outDistance. std::vector<DirectX::XMVECTOR> GetFrustumCornersWorldSpace(const DirectX::XMMATRIX& viewProj) Transforms the 8 DirectX NDC corners (x, y in {-1, 1}, z in {0, 1}) by Inverse(viewProj) with perspective divide; used by CSM cascade fitting.

docs.title: Engine::Scene (include/Engine/Scene.h)
docs.text: Central container managing the EnTT entity registry, play-mode backup registry, embedded sol::state Lua VM, entity factories, intrusive hierarchy links, and deferred destruction queue.

docs.title: Hierarchy, Lifecycle & Play-State Methods
docs.text: Signature Description void ParentEntity(entt::entity child, entt::entity parent) Performs ancestor cycle detection, detaches child from any prior parent, converts its world transform into local space relative to parent, and appends it to parent's intrusive child list. void UnparentEntity(entt::entity child) Removes child from its parent's sibling list and decomposes its cached worldMatrix into local TRS so its world transform is preserved. void DestroyEntity(entt::entity entity, Engine::PhysicsManager& physicsManager) Recursively destroys child entities, unparents entity, removes its Jolt rigid body, invokes Lua OnDestroy() callbacks, and destroys the EnTT handle. void SubmitForDestruction(entt::entity entity, float delay = 0.0f) Enqueues (entity, delay) in m_entitiesToDestroy (ignoring duplicates) for safe end-of-step deletion. void ProcessDestructionQueue(Engine::PhysicsManager& physicsManager, float deltaTime) Decrements queued timers and calls DestroyEntity on entries whose remaining time reaches <= 0.0f. void CopyToBackup() Clones all entities (preserving exact entt::entity IDs) and components from registry into m_backupRegistry. void RestoreFromBackup(Engine::PhysicsManager& physicsManager) Destroys active Jolt bodies and audio handles, clears registry, and restores all entities/components from m_backupRegistry with invalidated runtime handles. void StartPlayMode() Calls CopyToBackup(), runs ScriptSystemInit(*this), and switches m_activeRenderCamera to the first active non-editor camera. void StopPlayMode(entt::entity editorCameraFallback, Engine::PhysicsManager& physicsManager) Shuts down Lua scripts, calls RestoreFromBackup(physicsManager), and restores m_activeRenderCamera = editorCameraFallback. void InitializeLuaBindings(Engine::InputManager* inputManager, Engine::PhysicsManager* physicsManager) Opens standard Lua libraries and registers all engine usertypes, enums, and global tables into m_lua. void Clear(Engine::PhysicsManager& physicsManager) Destroys all Jolt bodies and audio handles, clears registry and m_entitiesToDestroy, and resets m_activeRenderCamera and m_currentScenePath. void GenerateDefaultSetup(Engine::PhysicsManager& physicsManager) Clears the scene and spawns Editor Camera, Main Camera, Sun Light, and a static 20 x 0.1 x 20 Ground box at y = -5.

docs.title: Engine::SceneSerializer (include/Engine/SceneSerializer.h)

Static JSON scene saver and 4-pass loader powered by RapidJSON.

docs.title: ECS & Entity Management
docs.text: Step Engine uses EnTT (entt::registry) as the backbone of its scene graph (Engine::Scene). Entities are lightweight 32-bit handles (entt::entity), components are Plain-Old-Data (POD) structs stored in contiguous sparse sets (include/Engine/Components.h), and behavior lives in stateless functions inside include/Engine/Systems.h.

docs.title: Component Architecture Overview
docs.text:
Every entity created via Scene::CreateEntity automatically receives three foundational components:

  1. IDComponent — A persistent 64-bit id used to serialize entities and rebuild hierarchies across save/load cycles.
  2. NameComponent — A human-readable name string and the master entity activation flag isActive. Systems (RenderSystem, PhysicsSystem, AudioSystem, Scene::CastRay) skip entities whose NameComponent::isActive is false.
  3. TransformComponent — Local-space translation (position), quaternion orientation (rotation), scale, a cached worldMatrix, and an isDirty flag.

Optional capability components can be attached in C++, through the Editor Inspector, or at runtime from Lua:

docs.title: Intrusive Entity Hierarchy (RelationshipComponent)
docs.text:
Rather than storing heap-allocated std::vector<entt::entity> child arrays on every entity, Step Engine links parent-child trees intrusively in O(1) memory per node using four entt::entity handles:

  • parent — The parent entity (entt::null if root).
  • firstChild — Head of the parent's doubly-linked child list.
  • prevSibling / nextSibling — Adjacent children sharing the same parent.
flowchart LR
    subgraph ParentNode ["Parent Entity (Model Root)"]
        P["RelationshipComponent<br/>parent: null<br/>firstChild: Child_0"]
    end

    subgraph Children ["Doubly-Linked Sibling Chain"]
        C0["Child_0 (Sub-mesh 0)<br/>parent: Parent<br/>prevSibling: null<br/>nextSibling: Child_1"]
        C1["Child_1 (Sub-mesh 1)<br/>parent: Parent<br/>prevSibling: Child_0<br/>nextSibling: Child_2"]
        C2["Child_2 (Sub-mesh 2)<br/>parent: Parent<br/>prevSibling: Child_1<br/>nextSibling: null"]
    end

    P -- "firstChild" --> C0
    C0 -- "nextSibling" --> C1
    C1 -- "prevSibling" --> C0
    C1 -- "nextSibling" --> C2
    C2 -- "prevSibling" --> C1

docs.title: World-Preserving Reparenting & Unparenting
docs.text:
Scene::ParentEntity(child, parent) and Scene::UnparentEntity(child) keep an entity visually stationary in world space when its hierarchy parent changes:

  1. Cycle Detection: ParentEntity walks upward from parent through RelationshipComponent::parent pointers. If child is encountered as an ancestor of parent (or child == parent), the operation aborts immediately to prevent infinite loops in TransformSystem.
  2. Detachment (UnparentEntity): Repairs the old parent's firstChild pointer and splices prevSibling / nextSibling around child. Decomposes child's cached worldMatrix directly into local scale, rotation, and position, and clears its RelationshipComponent links to entt::null.
  3. Local Space Conversion (ParentEntity): Computes the new local matrix relative to parent: 
    M_local = M_childWorld * Inverse(M_parentWorld)
    DirectX::XMMatrixDecompose extracts the updated local scale, rotation, and position into child's TransformComponent and sets isDirty = true.
  4. Sibling Appending: Emplaces RelationshipComponent on both entities if absent and appends child to the tail of parent's child list.

docs.title: Hierarchical Transform Propagation (TransformSystem)
docs.text:
TransformSystem(Scene&) runs every frame after physics, scripts, and camera input, ensuring TransformComponent::worldMatrix is up-to-date before rendering.

flowchart TD
    A["Iterate TransformComponent View (registry.view)"] --> B{"Is Root Entity?<br/>(No RelationshipComponent OR parent == null)"}
    B -- "No" --> A
    B -- "Yes" --> C["Recurse(entity, IdentityMatrix, parentChanged = false)"]
    C --> D["Build Local = Scale * RotationQuat * Translation"]
    D --> E{"Has Parent?"}
    E -- "No" --> F["World = Local"]
    E -- "Yes" --> G["World = Local * ParentWorld"]
    F --> H["Store tc.worldMatrix & clear tc.isDirty = false"]
    G --> H
    H --> I["dirty = wasDirty || parentChanged"]
    I --> J["For each child via firstChild -> nextSibling:<br/>Recurse(child, World, dirty)"]
  • Row-Major Convention: Step Engine uses DirectXMath row-major conventions throughout (Local = S * R * T and World = Local * ParentWorld), matching row_major float4x4 matrices and mul(rowVector, Matrix) in HLSL shaders.

docs.title: Factory Helpers on Scene
docs.text:
• Primitives & Empty Entities: CreateEntity, CreateCube, CreateSphere, CreateCapsule, CreateSampleEntity.
  • Cameras & Lights: CreateEditorCamera, CreateGameCamera, CreateDirectionalLight, CreatePointLight, CreateSpotLight.
  • Multi-Mesh Model Instantiation (Scene::InstantiateModel): Parses a .obj, .fbx, .gltf, or .glb file via MeshManager::LoadModel, creates a root entity named after the file stem (e.g., ABeautifulGame), and parents one child entity (<stem>_mesh_<i>) per sub-mesh with a pre-configured MeshRendererComponent.

docs.title: Cascading Immediate Destruction (Scene::DestroyEntity)
docs.text:
Calling Scene::DestroyEntity(entity, physicsManager) safely cleans up an entire subtree:

  1. Recursive Children First: Iterates firstChild -> nextSibling (caching nextSibling before recursion) and destroys every descendant depth-first.
  2. Hierarchy Unlink: Calls UnparentEntity(entity) to repair the parent's sibling list.
  3. Physics Cleanup: Removes and destroys any associated Jolt BodyID via PhysicsManager::RemoveRigidBody.
  4. Lua OnDestroy Hook: Invokes OnDestroy() via sol::protected_function on all initialized scripts attached to the entity.
  5. Registry Erasure: Calls registry.destroy(entity).

docs.title: Deferred Destruction Queue (SubmitForDestruction)
docs.text:
Lua scripts cannot safely call DestroyEntity mid-iteration without risking iterator invalidation. Instead, Entity:Destroy(delay) calls Scene::SubmitForDestruction(entity, delay), appending {entity, delay} (deduplicated) to Scene::m_entitiesToDestroy.

During Play Mode, Scene::ProcessDestructionQueue(physicsManager, deltaTime) runs after ScriptSystemUpdate and AudioSystem, decrementing timers in reverse index order and calling DestroyEntity once timeRemaining <= 0.0f.

docs.title: 4-Pass Scene Serialization (SceneSerializer)
docs.text:
SceneSerializer (src/Engine/SceneSerializer.cpp) persists scenes to JSON via RapidJSON while translating transient entt::entity handles into stable 64-bit IDComponent values and asset UUID handles.

sequenceDiagram
    participant Caller as EditorUI / main()
    participant Ser as SceneSerializer
    participant AM as AssetManager
    participant Scn as Scene & Registry

    Caller->>Ser: Deserialize(filepath, scene, physics, assetManager, outError)
    Ser->>AM: Read JSON (from VFS if active, else disk)
    Note over Ser,AM: Pass 1: Asset Validation
    Ser->>AM: Verify every Mesh, Albedo/Normal/ORM, Physics Mesh,<br/>Audio, Sprite, Font UUID & Script path exists
    alt Any Asset Missing
        Ser-->>Caller: Return false + outErrorMsg (Active scene untouched!)
    else All Assets Valid
        Note over Ser,Scn: Pass 2: Clear Current World
        Ser->>Scn: scene.Clear(physicsManager) & SetCurrentScenePath(filepath)
        Note over Ser,Scn: Pass 3: Rebuild Entities & Components
        Ser->>Scn: Create entities, emplace components, populate idMap[savedID -> entt::entity]
        Note over Ser,Scn: Pass 4: Restore Hierarchy
        Ser->>Scn: Translate Parent/FirstChild/PrevSibling/NextSibling IDs via idMap
        Ser-->>Caller: Return true
    end

docs.title: Core Engine Loop & Lifecycle
docs.text: The application entry point and frame orchestration live in src/main.cpp. Both DX11Editor and DX11Runtime compile from the same main() function, using the DIST_BUILD macro to specialize startup, input routing, simulation state, and render targets.

docs.text:

docs.title: Core Asset Bootstrapping (LoadCoreAssets)
docs.text:
Regardless of build target, LoadCoreAssets() initializes shared engine resources and caches their UUIDs on g_scene via Scene::SetDefaultAssets:

  1. Fallback 1x1 Textures: TextureManager::CreateDefaultTexture generates primitive://white (255, 255, 255, 255), primitive://default_normal (128, 128, 255, 255), and primitive://default_orm (255, 128, 0, 255).
  2. Core Shaders: ShaderManager loads shader://basic, shader://unlit, shader://skybox, shader://shadow, and shader://sprite.
  3. Procedural Primitives: MeshManager builds vertex/index buffers for primitive://cube, primitive://sphere_..., primitive://capsule_..., and primitive://quad.
  4. Default Skybox: TextureManager::LoadCubemap loads the 6 faces under assets/Textures/Skybox/ (right, left, top, bottom, front, back) and binds the resulting SRV via Renderer::SetSkybox.

UUID Stability Note: In DX11Editor, AssetManager::LoadRegistry("enginefiles/AssetRegistry.json") runs before LoadCoreAssets() so virtual paths such as primitive://cube reuse the exact same 64-bit UUIDs saved inside existing JSON scene files.

docs.text:
Frame delta time (dt) is computed in seconds using SDL2's hardware performance counter (SDL_GetPerformanceCounter / SDL_GetPerformanceFrequency). Each iteration of while (g_running) executes four phases: Event Polling, Simulation Update, Multi-Pass Rendering, and Application Control.

docs.title: Smart Input Routing in Editor Mode
docs.text:
When DX11Editor is running, Dear ImGui intercepts SDL_Event messages first via ImGuiManager::ProcessEvent. To prevent camera controls from getting stuck or blocked while interacting with the 3D viewport:

  1. InputManager::ProcessEvent still receives events whenever !imguiCaptured, g_input.IsMouseCaptured() (right-click fly mode), g_editorUI.IsSceneFocused(), or e.type == SDL_KEYUP (preventing stuck keys if focus shifts while a key is held).
  2. During Render(), if g_input.IsMouseCaptured() is true, ImGuiConfigFlags_NoMouse is set on ImGuiIO so cursor motion while flying the camera cannot accidentally hover or click ImGui widgets.

docs.title: Editor State Machine (Edit <-> Play)
docs.text:
EditorUI maintains an EditorState enum (Edit or Play) toggled from the top Toolbar. Entering Play Mode performs an in-memory snapshot so runtime physics forces, spawned entities, and script mutations never corrupt the authored scene.

flowchart TD
    Boot(["Editor Launch"]) --> Edit

    StartPlay["Scene::StartPlayMode()<br/>1. CopyToBackup()<br/>2. ScriptSystemInit() (OnCreate)<br/>3. Select active Game Camera"]

    StopPlay["Scene::StopPlayMode()<br/>1. ScriptSystemShutdown() (OnDestroy)<br/>2. RestoreFromBackup() (reset Jolt & Audio)<br/>3. Revert to cached m_editorCamera"]

    Play["EditorState::Play (Simulation Mode)<br/>- Side/bottom panels hidden (Scene view acts as Game view)<br/>- Active camera switched to first active Game Camera<br/>- Jolt steps simulation & flushes Lua collision events<br/>- ScriptSystemUpdate & AudioSystem active"]

    Restart["Scene Restart<br/>1. ScriptSystemShutdown()<br/>2. RestoreFromBackup() -> TransformSystem()<br/>3. ScriptSystemInit()"]

    StartPlay --> Play

    Play -- "Click Stop" --> StopPlay
    StopPlay --> Edit

docs.title: How CopyToBackup and RestoreFromBackup Work
docs.text:
• Scene::CopyToBackup(): Clears m_backupRegistry and iterates every entity in Scene::registry, calling m_backupRegistry.create(entity) to preserve the exact entt::entity identifier (including RelationshipComponent links) before copying all 14 core component types.
  • Scene::RestoreFromBackup(physicsManager):
    1. Removes and destroys all active Jolt BodyID instances from PhysicsManager.
    2. Calls AudioManager::DestroyAudio on all active AudioComponent::soundHandle instances.
    3. Clears Scene::registry and recreates every backed-up entity and component.
    4. Resets transient runtime handles (RigidBodyComponent::bodyID = JPH::BodyID(), bodyCreated = false, AudioComponent::soundHandle = nullptr, isPlaying = false) so PhysicsSystem and AudioSystem cleanly rebuild fresh runtime instances on the next frame.

docs.title: Ordered Shutdown Sequence
docs.text:
When the main loop exits (ESC, window close, or Game.Quit()):

  1. Save Asset Registry (Editor only): g_assetManager.SaveRegistry("enginefiles/AssetRegistry.json") persists all known asset UUIDs.
  2. Clear Scene: g_scene.Clear(g_physicsManager) removes every Jolt body, destroys every miniaudio sound instance, and clears the EnTT registry.
  3. Subsystem Teardown: Shuts down managers in reverse dependency order: AudioManager::Shutdown() -> PhysicsManager::Shutdown() -> FontManager::Shutdown() -> ImGuiManager::Shutdown() (Editor only) -> Renderer::Shutdown() -> SDL_DestroyWindow & SDL_Quit().

docs.title: Rendering Pipeline & Shaders
docs.text: Step Engine implements a multi-pass DirectX 11 forward renderer encapsulated by Engine::Renderer (src/Engine/Renderer.cpp) and driven each frame by Engine::RenderSystem (src/Engine/Systems.cpp) and HLSL Shader Model 5.0 programs (shaders/*.hlsl).

docs.title: Render Targets: Editor Framebuffer vs. Standalone Back Buffer
docs.text:
Renderer::InitD3D11 creates a hardware ID3D11Device, immediate ID3D11DeviceContext, and a double-buffered DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM swap chain with a DXGI_FORMAT_D24_UNORM_S8_UINT depth-stencil buffer.

  • Editor Builds (DX11Editor): Renderer::CreateFramebuffer allocates an independent off-screen R8G8B8A8_UNORM color texture (D3D11_BIND_RENDER_TARGET | D3D11_BIND_SHADER_RESOURCE) paired with a D24_UNORM_S8_UINT depth buffer. All 3D geometry, debug wireframes, skyboxes, and 2D HUD elements render into this off-screen target (BindFramebuffer()), which EditorUI::DrawSceneView displays inside a dockable Dear ImGui window via ImGui::Image(renderer.GetFramebufferSRV(), viewportSize). Resizing the ImGui Scene panel dynamically resizes both ViewportComponent and the off-screen framebuffer.
  • Standalone Builds (DX11Runtime, DIST_BUILD): All passes render directly to the swap chain back buffer (BindBackBuffer()), and window resize events update both the swap chain buffers and the active camera's ViewportComponent.

docs.title: Physically Based Shading (BasicVS.hlsl & BasicPS.hlsl)
docs.text:
Lit surfaces (MaterialType::LitColor and MaterialType::Textured) use a metallic-roughness Cook-Torrance microfacet BRDF:

Lo(p, V) = (0.03 * albedo * ao)
         + sum_i [ (kD * albedo / PI + (D * G * F) / (4 * NdotV * NdotL)) * radiance_i * NdotL ]
  • Normal Mapping (TBN): BasicPS.hlsl re-orthogonalizes the interpolated tangent T against the normal N using Gram-Schmidt (T = normalize(T - dot(T, N) * N)), computes B = cross(N, T), and transforms the unpacked tangent-space normal (sampled * 2 - 1) into world space.
  • Fallback Safety: In LitColor mode (or when a texture slot is unassigned in Textured mode), RenderSystem binds 1x1 fallback textures (White albedo, flat (128, 128, 255) normal, and (255, 128, 0) ORM) to t0–t2 so shader equations remain branch-free without texture state leakage.
  • Multi-Light Culling & Sorting:
    • Supports Directional (0), Point (1), and Spot (2) lights.
    • RenderSystem::DrawEntities builds a world-space DirectX::BoundingFrustum from the active camera and culls off-screen Point and Spot lights using BoundingSphere(position, range).
    • Remaining lights are sorted by squared distance to the camera (with Directional lights given distSq = -1.0f so they always occupy the front slots) and capped at MAX_LIGHTS (16). If a scene has zero active lights, a fallback white directional light (intensity = 1.0f) is uploaded automatically.

docs.title: Cascaded Shadow Maps (CSM)
docs.text:
Directional lights cast shadows across large scenes using 3 frustum cascades (Renderer::NUM_CASCADES = 3):

  1. Frustum Partitioning: Renderer::CalculateCascadeMatrices splits the active camera's [nearClip, farClip] range at 5%, 20%, and 100%.
  2. Bounding-Sphere Orthographic Fit: For each sub-frustum, Engine::Math::GetFrustumCornersWorldSpace unprojects its 8 NDC corners into world space. The engine encloses those 8 corners in a rotationally invariant bounding sphere of radius r and builds a light-space orthographic volume ([-r, r] in X/Y, with zPadding = 500.0f along the light vector to capture shadow casters behind the camera).
  3. Texel Snapping: To eliminate shadow-edge shimmering ("swimming") during camera movement, the world origin is projected into light space and rounded to exact 2.0f / 2048.0f shadow texel increments.
  4. Acne & Filtering: Hardware rasterizer SlopeScaledDepthBias = 1.5f plus a 0.0001f shader bias prevent self-shadowing acne, while BasicPS.hlsl selects the cascade slice using camera-space viewZ and performs 3x3 Percentage-Closer Filtering (PCF) (SampleLevel) for soft shadow penumbras.

docs.title: Skybox, Debug Colliders & 2D UI Passes
docs.text:
• Debug Collider Pass (RenderSystem::DrawDebugColliders): Active only in DX11Editor during Edit mode when the selected entity has an active RigidBodyComponent with showWireframe == true. Switches to m_wireframeRasterizerState (D3D11_FILL_WIREFRAME, D3D11_CULL_NONE) and renders the collider's exact physical dimensions in solid green (UnlitVS / UnlitPS).
  • Skybox Pass (Renderer::DrawSkybox): Strips translation from the camera view matrix, scales the unit cube by 50.0f, disables face culling, sets depth comparison to D3D11_COMPARISON_LESS_EQUAL, and outputs o.pos = float4(p.x, p.y, p.w, p.w) in SkyboxVS.hlsl so normalized depth equals 1.0 and fills only background pixels untouched by 3D geometry.
  • 2D UI / HUD Pass (RenderSystem::DrawUI): Enables SRC_ALPHA / INV_SRC_ALPHA blending, disables depth testing/writing, and sets a top-left pixel orthographic projection (XMMatrixOrthographicOffCenterLH(0, width, height, 0, 0, 1)). Both sprites and font glyphs draw a shared 1x1 unit quad (primitive://quad), passing sub-rectangle UV offsets and scales [uOffset, vOffset, uScale, vScale] through row 0 of b1 (g_View[0]) in SpriteVS.hlsl.

docs.title: Shader Compilation & Bytecode Caching (ShaderManager)
docs.text:
ShaderManager::GetShaderBytecode bridges live authoring and standalone distribution:

  • Editor Mode (!IsVFSActive()): Compiles .hlsl source files at startup via D3DCompileFromFile (vs_5_0 / ps_5_0, adding D3DCOMPILE_DEBUG | D3DCOMPILE_SKIP_OPTIMIZATION in _DEBUG builds), writes the compiled bytecode to shaders/*.cso on disk, and registers the .cso file in AssetManager so PackAssets includes pre-compiled shaders in data.pak.
  • Runtime Mode (IsVFSActive()): Reads pre-compiled shaders/*.cso bytecode directly out of data.pak without requiring .hlsl source files or runtime compilation.

docs.title: Subsystems, Physics, Audio & VFS
docs.text:
Step Engine coordinates its runtime subsystems around two shared hubs: Engine::Scene (which owns the EnTT registry and sol::state Lua VM) and Engine::AssetManager (which maps 64-bit UUIDs to disk paths or data.pak VFS byte ranges).
